title: Minimum Hydrostatic Test Pressure Ratio
message_template: Hydrostatic test ratio {value} is below mandatory ASME VIII-1 UG-99(b) factor of {limit}.
recommendation_template: Increase hydrostatic test pressure ratio to at least {limit} times MAWP multiplied by the lowest stress ratio pursuant to ASME Section VIII Division 1 clause {clause}.

title: Maximum Pneumatic Test Pressure Ratio
message_template: Pneumatic test ratio {value} exceeds maximum ASME VIII-1 UG-100(b) limit of {limit}.
recommendation_template: Ensure pneumatic test pressure ratio does not exceed {limit} times MAWP corrected for temperature as specified in clause {clause}.

title: Weld Joint Efficiency Factor Permitted Range
message_template: Weld joint efficiency {value} is outside permitted standard range [0.45, 1.00] under clause {clause}.
recommendation_template: Assign a standard joint efficiency factor E between {min_val} and {max_val} in accordance with Table UW-12 based on weld type and degree of radiographic examination.

title: SA-516 Grade 70 Permitted Design Temperature Limits
message_template: Temperature {value}{unit} for {parameter} violates ASME Section II-D / Section VIII-1 UCS-23 allowable limits.
recommendation_template: Verify that design temperature remains between {min_val}°C and {max_val}°C or select appropriate alloy per Section II-D Table 1A.

title: Governed Pressure Unit Consistency
message_template: Non-standard or obsolete pressure unit '{unit}' found for {parameter}.
recommendation_template: Convert pressure units to approved ASME Section VIII SI/US-Customary standard units: {canonical} or {allowed}.

title: Allowable Stress Unit Consistency
recommendation_template: Use standard stress units ({canonical} or {allowed}) conforming to ASME Section II Part D / UG-23.

title: Standard Terminology for Minimum Design Metal Temperature
message_template: Deprecated terminology '{deprecated}' used instead of governed term '{preferred}'.
recommendation_template: Replace deprecated term with governed technical term '{preferred}' as defined in clause {clause}.

title: Standard Terminology for Maximum Allowable Working Pressure
message_template: Informal or obsolete pressure term '{deprecated}' used instead of codified term '{preferred}'.
recommendation_template: Use codified term '{preferred}' pursuant to ASME Section VIII Division 1 clause {clause}.

title: Mandatory Normative Reference to ASME Section IX for Welding Procedures
message_template: Specification references '{trigger}' but lacks required normative reference to {required_standard}.
recommendation_template: Add normative citation to {required_standard} for welding and brazing procedure qualifications per clause {clause}.

title: Mandatory Normative Reference to ASME Section V for NDE Examination
message_template: Specification mandates '{trigger}' without required normative reference to {required_standard}.
recommendation_template: Incorporate normative reference to {required_standard} per ASME VIII-1 clause {clause}.

title: Mandatory Impact Test Exemption Evaluation per UCS-66
message_template: Specification claims '{trigger}' without citing governing ASME VIII-1 clause {required_standard}.
recommendation_template: Formally document impact test exemption curve and temperature reduction under clause {required_standard}.
